requirements.statement: The system shall allow a user to sign up and log in using email and password.
requirements.verification_method: API and Playwright tests for successful and rejected sign-up/login flows

requirements.statement: The system shall maintain a user profile containing name, role, department, and start date.
requirements.verification_method: API schema tests and Playwright profile display/edit tests after edit rules are approved

requirements.statement: The system shall enforce distinct New Recruit, Manager, and Admin capabilities.
requirements.verification_method: Role-matrix authorization tests for every protected API and UI operation

requirements.statement: The system shall allow an Admin to manage users and view all data.
requirements.verification_method: Admin API and Playwright tests plus non-admin denial tests

requirements.statement: A New Recruit shall be able to create, edit, and delete task entries with date, title, description, category, status, and priority, and filter tasks by date, category, or status.
requirements.verification_method: Task API CRUD/filter tests and Playwright task-log scenarios

requirements.statement: A New Recruit shall be able to log issues or blockers with date, title, description, severity, status, and resolution notes, and filter issues by status or severity.
requirements.verification_method: Issue API/filter tests and Playwright issue-log scenarios after lifecycle rules are approved

requirements.statement: A New Recruit shall be able to submit onboarding feedback with date, subject, type, and details, where type is Positive, Suggestion, or Concern.
requirements.verification_method: Feedback API validation tests and Playwright submission scenarios

requirements.statement: A New Recruit shall be able to capture additional notes with date, title, content, and tags.
requirements.verification_method: Note API/tag validation tests and Playwright note-entry scenarios

requirements.statement: The dashboard shall show summary counts and recent entries across all diary categories.
requirements.verification_method: Seeded API aggregation tests and Playwright dashboard display tests

requirements.statement: The dashboard shall show task-completion progress and open issues at a glance.
requirements.verification_method: Seeded boundary tests for progress/open-issue calculations and Playwright display tests

requirements.statement: The system shall generate reports for an inclusive or exclusive date range as approved, containing tasks, issues, feedback, or a combined selection.
requirements.verification_method: Report query tests with boundary dates and each content selection

requirements.statement: The system shall provide generated reports as downloadable PDF or CSV files.
requirements.verification_method: Artifact tests for media type, filename, parseability, content, and authorization

requirements.statement: A Manager shall be able to generate reports for recruits the Manager oversees.
requirements.verification_method: Authorization tests using assigned and unassigned recruit fixtures

requirements.statement: The application shall be a responsive web application.
requirements.verification_method: Playwright viewport tests at approved browser and viewport matrix

requirements.statement: Application data shall be stored in the mandated in-memory SQLite database with an approved data-lifetime contract.
requirements.source: Invocation requested_stack.database and BRD page 2, Technical Notes
requirements.verification_method: Integration tests for storage and approved restart/reset behavior

requirements.statement: The frontend shall use React with Vite and Tailwind CSS, and the backend shall use Python FastAPI.
requirements.verification_method: Repository dependency/configuration inspection and startup smoke test

requirements.statement: The system shall provide approved validation, authorization, and recoverable user-facing failure behavior for all core flows.
requirements.source: Derived from the need for testable authentication, forms, APIs, and report generation
requirements.verification_method: Negative API tests and Playwright failure-state scenarios after behavior is approved

requirements.statement: The delivered application shall include at least two additional approved features beyond the core application.
requirements.verification_method: Feature-specific automated and Playwright tests to be defined after selection
